statement.zh: 假说：将全部远大洋洲定居简化为单一「拉皮塔移民波」的模型过于粗糙，区域变异与多阶段过程需保留（Green/Sheppard 讨论语境）。
statement.en: Hypothesis: reducing all Remote Oceanic settlement to a single ‘Lapita migration wave’ is too coarse; regional variation and multi-stage processes must be retained (Green/Sheppard discussion context).

disclaimer: Hypothesis: single-wave migration models are debated; not established fact.

editorial.notes: Wave-1 densify to library-seed-rich (D-2026-10-12-13). No invented pages/coords/finds/media art. Honest thin > fake dense.
